Lines.en: NEIGHBORINO! Last night's bash was totally TACO-TASTIC!
Lines.zh: 邻居，昨晚的派对真过瘾啊

Lines.en: I hope you didn't clean up those taco shells on the lawn! We can reuse 'em for tonight's FIESTA-PALOOZA!
Lines.zh: 我希望你没有清理昨晚留在草坪上的玉米卷，这样我们就可以再嗨一晚！

Lines.en: I do not wish to interrupt your planning
Lines.zh: 我不想打断你们的计划

Lines.en: But I calculate you did not obtain owner authorization when acquiring these materials
Lines.zh: 但我认为你们借这些东西时一定没征得所有者的同意

Lines.en: No worries! We've got the Repeater - it's like limited edition tacos but with MORE PEPPER!
Lines.zh: 不用担心，我们有堪比限量版玉米卷的双发射手

Lines.en: Let's serve 'em to the zombies! They'll be BEGGING to renew their lease!
Lines.zh: 把他送给僵尸们，它们会同意续租的

Lines.en: User Dave, my analysis indicates 23.23% of power-oriented entities would disapprove this transaction
Lines.zh: 用户戴夫，经过我的测算，有23.23％的慕强主义者不会同意这笔买卖

Lines.en: Additionally, our plant storage has been converted to potato storage overnight. I cannot detect Repeater presence
Lines.zh: 而且，我们的植物仓库在一夜之间变成了洋芋仓库，我无法检测到双发射手的存在

Lines.en: PENNY! QUICK! Turn these spuds into POTATACOS! Our bonfire bash depends on it!
Lines.zh: 潘尼，快去把这些洋芋做成洋芋卷，这样我们就能继续开篝火晚会了！
